companyProfile.title: Company profile
companyProfile.subtitle: Keep your public and legal company details up to date. Public details apply immediately; legal details and documents require university review.
companyProfile.permissionBody: You don't have permission to view this company profile.
companyProfile.readOnlyBanner: You have view-only access to the company profile. Contact an organization admin for edit access.
companyProfile.conflictBody: This profile was just changed elsewhere. We reloaded the latest version.

public.title: Public information
public.intro: Students see this on your job posts and company page.

legal.title: Legal identity
legal.reviewHint: Changes to legal identity require university review before they take effect.
legal.lockedBody: Legal identity can't be edited until the university decides on your current request. Withdraw the request to edit again.

pending.title: Awaiting university review
pending.body: The following sensitive changes are awaiting university approval.
pending.withdrawConfirmBody: The pending request is cancelled and the proposed changes won't be applied. You can submit again later.

docs.title: Verification documents
docs.intro: Upload a business license, tax certificate, or legal document. Every document requires university review.
docs.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 10 MB.
docs.errTooLarge: File is too large. Choose a file under 10 MB.
docs.errUnsupported: Unsupported format. Use PDF, PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
docs.errEmpty: The file is empty. Choose a valid file.

companyProfile.logoIntro: Your logo appears on job posts, your company page, and search results.
companyProfile.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to about 3 MB.
companyProfile.logoReadOnly: You don't have permission to change the logo.
companyProfile.logoRemoveBody: Students will see an initials placeholder until you upload a new logo.

logoErr.emptyFile: The file is empty. Please choose a valid image.
logoErr.tooLarge: The image is too large. Please choose a file under 3 MB.
logoErr.unsupportedType: Unsupported format. Please use PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
logoErr.conflict: The profile was just changed elsewhere. We reloaded the latest version — please try again.
logoErr.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
logoErr.generic: Couldn't update the logo. Please try again.
